name: OpenSSL 'Heartbleed'
defect: The TLS heartbeat handler copied a claimed payload length without checking it against the record, leaking up to 16 KiB of process memory. The vulnerable releases are OpenSSL 1.0.1a..1.0.1f; the fixed release is 1.0.1g (the CVE-2014-0160 fix release). The probe (src/hb.c) performs the exact historical exploit message sequence — ClientHello with the heartbeat extension, then the malformed heartbeat immediately after ServerHelloDone — against the linked library's own protocol code. The leak court observes TWO narrow semantic axes: tls.heartbeat.illegal_response (was the malformed heartbeat ANSWERED, RFC 6520 §4) and memory.leak.seeded_canary (did the planted synthetic canary bytes escape). RAW-MEMORY PUBLICATION BOUNDARY: the probe never writes the echoed process memory to any observed stream — it reports a projection (length, SHA-256 commitment, canary observation).

build.official_tarballs: the 7 OpenSSL 1.0.1 tarballs from openssl.org, pinned by SHA-256 in build/build-manifest.json

leak_study.comparators: comparators/heartbeat-verdict.py (relation eq, extractor verdict-scan; the malformed heartbeat was answered) + comparators/heartbeat-canary.py (relation eq, extractor canary-scan; the exact planted canary bytes escaped) — no entropy heuristic, no markers
leak_study.raw_memory_boundary: the probe never writes the echoed process memory to any observed stream — it plants a deterministic synthetic canary and reports the projection (len, sha256, canary, fraction)
leak_study.minimizer: minimizers/heartbeat-length.py (kappa route leak-minimize; reduces the claimed payload length)
leak_study.mutation: mutations/seed-leak.py (operator seed-leak; proposes a mutant reproducing the exact observable leak shape — canary=present projection + HEARTBLEED verdict — deterministic and synthetic)
leak_study.minimal_trigger: claimed payload length 0x0FE9 (4073) — the lowest claimed length at which this admitted 1.0.1f court/probe configuration produces the observable residual (an observation boundary, not an intrinsic Heartbleed minimum; below it the response is constructed but never flushed to the wire)
leak_study.evidence: evidence/ (regenerated by study.sh / reproduce.sh run; deterministic content-addressed ids)
leak_study.claim: claims/heartbleed-trajectory.md (the comparative claim + the measured lifecycle table)

challenge: seed-leak (the sensitivity proof: a seeded leak must be seen on both leak observables and nothing else)

clean_control.expectation: no residual on any axis (with the handshake-only clean fixture, the vulnerable and fixed builds are byte-identical on exit and stderr)
